description: This Java class produces JSON example files for testing or documentation related to the 'thingsearch' feature in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It builds search queries, generates command objects, and writes their JSON representations to files, demonstrating usage of the search model and related commands.

classes.name: ThingSearchJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates example JSON files for testing or documentation, related to search commands and responses in the 'thingsearch' module of Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that initiates the process of generating JSON example files based on a provided directory path.

methods.name: produceSudoCommands
methods.description: Creates various search command and response objects, converts them to JSON, and writes them to files within a specified directory.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Writes a JSON string to a specified file path, logging the operation.
